Also on the QM under user actions as well! Will help make inviting people to your created groups + groups you have invite perms in a breeze!

This was implemented in our latest patch! You can open your Quick Menu, click on someone, then click "Invite to Group".

Select the group you want to invite them to, and you're good to go.

You can also invite people from their main profile page.

Note that in this version, *all* groups that you are a member of are listed in that menu, not just the ones you have permission to invite to. This is a technical limitation that we'll try our best to address later.

This has not yet been implemented on the web pages.
